title: VDBE creation, connection linkage, and Parse ownership

scope.rationale: sqlite3VdbeCreate atomically allocates the statement object, initializes the zero-required tail, links it at the connection head, establishes Parse ownership, and appends mandatory OP_Init. sqlite3VdbeParser is the inverse owner accessor. The intrusive-list fields have no independent behavior outside this lifecycle.
excluded_responsibilities: VDBE MakeReady allocation and execution-state transition

external_source_responsibilities: Connection mutex ownership at production call sites
Parse initialization before first VDBE creation
dependencies.caller_closure: Creation, intrusive head linkage, Parse/Vdbe bidirectional ownership, parser accessor, mandatory Init append, object-allocation OOM and Init-append OOM are assigned. Readiness, deletion and production compiler ownership remain follow-on units.

inputs: initialized Parse with db, null aLabel, zero nLabel and szOpAlloc
connection allocator/lookaside and current pVdbe head
outputs: new Vdbe at db.pVdbe, Parse pVdbe owner, reciprocal intrusive links, INIT-state tail, attempted OP_Init(0,1)
contracts.ownership: The connection owns the allocated Vdbe through pVdbe. Parse records the same owner. The prior head remains connection-owned and its ppVPrev is retargeted to the new pVNext slot.
contracts.state_and_results: Only bytes from aOp through the Vdbe tail are zeroed, matching offsetof semantics. db/pVNext/ppVPrev/pParse are assigned explicitly; mandatory Init append may leave a linked zero-op Vdbe under sticky OOM.
contracts.locks_callbacks_io: Caller holds the connection mutex. No callback or I/O occurs.
contracts.failure_and_continuation: Object allocation failure returns null and does not mutate linkage. Operation allocation failure returns the linked Vdbe, leaves nOp zero and sticky connection OOM, allowing ordinary VDBE cleanup.

representation_differences: C memset begins at offsetof(Vdbe,aOp); Zig byte memset uses @offsetOf and @sizeOf over the same verified extern layout.
C Parse uses its Vdbe declaration; Zig crosses the generated Parse/Vdbe declaration cycle with an ABI-identical pointer cast.
Intrusive ppVPrev pointer-to-owner-slot identity is retained directly rather than replaced by a container.

oracle.protocol: The shared symbolic builder worker creates one and two linked statements and injects deterministic object-allocation and initial-operation-allocation faults with lookaside disabled. C and Zig compare ownership/accessor identity, list links, state, Init operands/capacity, and OOM Parse/connection state in a 366-observation trace.
internal_observations: db head and Parse owner pointer identity
pVNext and ppVPrev reciprocal slot identity
Init append OOM linked continuation path
oracle.normalization: Pointer values are normalized to exact identity/relationship booleans. Counts, state, operands, OOM flags and result codes are exact.

assurance.oom: Both Vdbe object-allocation failure and second-allocation OP_Init failure are deterministically reached and compared; cleanup returns lookaside/global storage.
assurance.io_crash_concurrency: No I/O or callback. Production mutex/cross-statement lifecycle remains integration work.
assurance.malformed_input: Source assertions require zero labels/allocation metadata and initialized Parse/db; worker exercises valid entry contracts.
assurance.continuation: Linked VdBE after Init OOM is observed and safely retired; normal one/two-node lists are retired between cases.
assurance.performance: Single allocation, tail memset, O(1) intrusive head insertion and one opcode append preserve source shape.

integration.native_call_path: Symbolic native worker calls create against exact Parse/Sqlite3/Vdbe owners. Production handwritten compiler still owns executable programs.
integration.bounded_owner_retired: No. Production ownership waits for P4/MakeReady/deletion and compiler migration.

independent_review.notes: Requires lifecycle integration, assurance closure, and independent review.

known_blockers: Port and integrate P4 ownership, MakeReady/operation transfer, and deletion.
Switch compiler ownership from handwritten Program to source VDBE builder and retire the duplicate.

implementation_spans: upstream/sqlite/src/vdbeaux.c:1-55 was reviewed completely for object allocation, tail zeroing, intrusive connection-head insertion, Parse linkage, assertions, mandatory Init append, and inverse parser accessor
upstream/sqlite/src/sqliteInt.h sqlite3/Parse neighborhoods were reviewed for both pVdbe owners; upstream/sqlite/src/vdbeInt.h:440-480 was reviewed for Vdbe intrusive fields and zero-tail boundary
select.c:2490 and vdbeblob.c:250 direct creation callers plus expr.c parser accessor were inspected
src/core/internal/vdbe_aux.zig create/parser and exact layout fields are canonical AST-hashed targets
callers: select.c sqlite3GetVdbe creates the main compiler VDBE lazily; vdbeblob.c creates the incremental-blob statement VDBE
expr.c uses sqlite3VdbeParser to recover Parse ownership from a VDBE
Connection close/finalize owns later unlink/delete; MakeReady owns transition out of INIT and remains separate
callees: Create allocates exactly sizeof(Vdbe) through sqlite3DbMallocRawNN and returns null without mutation on object OOM
It zeroes from aOp through the tail, assigns db, inserts at db.pVdbe head with reciprocal ppVPrev/pVNext links, links Parse both ways, and appends Init(0,1)
Initial operation allocation failure leaves a linked zero-op VDBE under sticky OOM so ordinary cleanup can retire it
Parser accessor returns pParse directly; no callback or I/O occurs
assertions_branches_cleanup: All ten behavior IDs cover allocation/no-mutation OOM, prior-head retargeting, INIT/zero-state assertions, return, and parser access
Connection mutex is a caller obligation; allocated VDBE ownership transfers to connection list immediately before Init append
Tail memset intentionally excludes db/list fields before explicit assignment and preserves source offsetof semantics
upstream_tests: Upstream prepare, incremental blob, OOM, statement lifecycle, and connection-close suites exercise creation, linkage, failed Init append, and cleanup
Project builder differential creates one/two statements and deterministic object/Init allocation failures, comparing exact reciprocal identities, state, Init operands, and OOM continuation
